# BNP Paribas Asset Management launches Antin Sélection Opportunités. **BNP Paribas Asset Management launches Antin Sélection Opportunités, a multi-manager fund of funds eligible for PEAs (equity savings plans)**. In response to growing demand from BNP Paribas Banque Privée France customers for funds with an absolute performance

**BNP Paribas Asset Management launches Antin Sélection Opportunités, a multi-manager fund of funds eligible for PEAs (equity savings plans)**. In response to growing demand from BNP Paribas Banque Privée France customers for funds with an absolute performance objective, BNP Paribas Asset Management has created Antin Sélection Opportunités. The portfolio of this fund of funds (French and European equities eligible for PEA plans (1)) reflects the continuing selection of talented managers with the discretion to make strong bets to generate regular outperformances. **Using our multi-management expertise for PEAs**.
